title: List Drop Bound
statement: For lists $x,r$ of Boolean values, a natural number $p$, and a Boolean value $b$, if deleting the first $p$ entries of $x$ gives a list whose first entry is $b$ and whose remaining tail is $r$, then $p<|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: Dropping the first $p$ entries of $x$ gives $b::r$
